_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_probate_court.label: County (Probate Court)
county_probate_court.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

name_of_adoptee.label: Name of Adoptee
name_of_adoptee.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

docket_no.label: Docket No.
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

birth_mother_name.label: Birth Mother Name
birth_mother_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

name_of_child.label: Name of Child
name_of_child.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

surrender_release_recipient.label: Surrender and Release Recipient (Maine DHHS or licensed adoption agency)
surrender_release_recipient.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

putative_parent_name.label: Putative Parent Last Known Name
putative_parent_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

putative_parent_address.label: Putative Parent Last Known Address
putative_parent_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

putative_parent_statements.label: Putative Parent Statements
putative_parent_statements.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

pregnancy_date.label: Pregnancy Date (on or about)
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

putative_parent_likely_address.label: Putative Parent's Most Likely Address
putative_parent_likely_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

location_reasons.label: Reasons for Believed Location
location_reasons.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

newspaper_name_address.label: Newspaper Name and Address
newspaper_name_address.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

newspaper_reasons.label: Reasons for Newspaper Choice
newspaper_reasons.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notary_county.label: Notary County
notary_county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

notary_acknowledgment_date.label: Acknowledgment Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

notary_acknowledgment_year.label: Acknowledgment Year
avoid: text spanning the printed '20' stub — fill only the remaining digits if the form prints '20__'

name_of_appearer.label: Name of Personally Appearing Affiant
name_of_appearer.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

notary_print_name.label: Notary Print Name
notary_print_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

date_commission_expires.label: Date Commission Expires
date_commission_expires.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
